messages:
maria-cs: Hey team — acme-prod just escalated. Their org hit 0 tokens mid-deploy and kept getting 429s for ~40m. They expected monthly refill at 00:00 local TZ. UI still showed 0 even after our billing job completed.

lynn-support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the org id and a short repro? Any logs or timestamps from the customer?

maria-cs: Org: org_acme_82. Plan: pro-monthly. TZ: America/Los_Angeles. They ran a mass deployment with ~500 parallel streaming sessions. Customer clipped repeated 429s, then waited, no change.

sam-eng: Quick hypothesis: refill landed in DB but gateway or streaming in-memory counters stayed stale. Two checks: did monthly-refill write to the DB? what's in gateway/redis cache?

sam-eng: Run these if you have admin creds:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.ai/internal/billing/orgs/org_acme_82/credits
redis-cli GET credits:org:org_acme_82
```

infra-bot: monthly-refill job ran at 2026-03-01T00:00:05Z for org_acme_82 -> db_update=success (tokens_added=1000000)

lynn-support: So DB refill=success. Customer still saw 0 in UI/api. Can someone confirm gateway cache TTL and whether streaming sessions hold local counters that don't reconcile on refill?

sam-eng: There's an existing behavior: long-lived websocket streams maintain local in-memory counters and only reconcile on reconnect or periodic sync. If a stream stays alive after exhaustion, the edge may still report zero until it syncs.

maria-cs: Customer confirmed they did not restart streams; they only restarted after ~40m and credits appeared immediately.

sam-eng: Root cause (likely): refill applied to central ledger, but edge-level streaming counters remained at exhausted state until session reconnect. Gateway cache (redis) still held 0 for the org until TTL or manual invalidation.

lynn-support: Short-term mitigations: 1) Offer customer a one-time top-up to unblock now. 2) Ask them to restart/reconnect streams. 3) We can trigger a cache purge for the org.

sam-eng: Long-term: publish a refill event on our pubsub so gateway edges reconcile streaming counters proactively. Also add a health check comparing DB vs cache and alert if mismatch > threshold.

maria-cs: I'll offer the top-up and send reconnect instructions. I'll also collect the customer's logs and exact reconnect time for the ticket.

sam-eng: I'll open ENG-7145 with repro steps and include the refill job logs + gateway cache snapshot. Quick patch: when refill job succeeds, also push a "credits_reconciliate" event to edges.

infra-bot: Created ticket ENG-7145 and linked runbook 'streaming-credit-reconcile'.

lynn-support: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and mark as escalated.
